header: What the published tolerance figures do not promise
content:
Tolerance and lead-time figures on this site describe series production under our standard process. They are indicative and form no part of a contract. The binding values are those written into the released drawing revision and the order confirmation.

Material data is reproduced from supplier certificates. Where a part is safety-critical, ask the Graz engineering desk for a written suitability statement before you release it for production.
